# SMS Activate by SIMNETIQ

> SMS Activate is a mobile app (iOS and Android) by SIMNETIQ LTD that provides temporary virtual phone numbers in 50+ countries for receiving SMS verification codes, so people can sign up for online services (Telegram, WhatsApp, Google, Instagram and 35+ more) without revealing their personal phone number. simnetiq.xyz is the official website, available in English and Russian.

Key facts:
- Pricing: one-time in-app credit packs (1, 5 or 10 activations); one credit per successful activation; no subscription; credits never expire. Exact prices are shown in the app and vary by store and region.
- A code typically arrives within seconds; a pending activation can be cancelled in the app and the credit is returned.
- No SIM or eSIM is installed; numbers are for one-time verification codes, not for long-term use or 2FA.
- Operator: SIMNETIQ LTD, a company registered in England and Wales. Support: support@simnetiq.store (replies usually within one business day).
- Download: App Store https://apps.apple.com/us/app/sms-activate/id6768591062 · Google Play https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.theholylabs.esim

## Pages

- [Home](https://simnetiq.xyz/): what the app does, how it works in three steps, supported services, pricing packs, FAQ
- [Virtual numbers hub](https://simnetiq.xyz/virtual-numbers): index of all per-service and per-country guides
- [Service guides](https://simnetiq.xyz/virtual-numbers/telegram): one guide per service (Telegram, WhatsApp, Google, Instagram, TikTok, Discord, Facebook, X, Snapchat, Tinder, Viber, Signal, Steam, PayPal, Apple, Netflix, Uber, AliExpress, WeChat, LINE, Airbnb, Grab, VK, adidas, Cursor) at /virtual-numbers/<service> — the real verification flow, service-specific tips and FAQs
- [Country guides](https://simnetiq.xyz/virtual-numbers/country/united-states): one guide per country (US, UK, Germany, France, Poland, Ukraine, Kazakhstan, Netherlands, Indonesia, Philippines, India, Brazil, Canada, Spain, Italy) at /virtual-numbers/country/<country> — dialing codes, formats, what each country's numbers suit
- [Comparisons](https://simnetiq.xyz/alternatives/sms-activate-org): fair comparisons with sms-activate.org, 5SIM, OnlineSIM, SMS-Man and TextVerified at /alternatives/<competitor>
- [Blog](https://simnetiq.xyz/blog): guides on virtual numbers, privacy and SMS verification
- [Support](https://simnetiq.xyz/support): contact form and self-help for activation, billing and restore-purchase issues
- [Privacy Policy](https://simnetiq.xyz/privacy-policy): what data is collected and how it is used (UK GDPR)
- [Terms of Service](https://simnetiq.xyz/terms-of-service): acceptable use, credits, disclaimers, governing law (England and Wales)
